cultural.summary: Tuck dry wild mint leaves in with your stored wheat—bugs and mold hate it!
cultural.how: Mix dry Bangru (Mentha arvensis) leaves into stored wheat grain.

cultural.summary: Layer in this traditional leafy herb to keep stored grain fungus-free and pest-free!
cultural.how: Mix dry Kali Basuti (Adhatoda vasica) leaves into stored wheat grain.

cultural.summary: Fragrant eucalyptus leaves tucked into your grain bin, standing guard against sneaky storage fungi!
cultural.how: Mix dry Safeda (Eucalyptus citriodora) leaves into stored wheat grain.

cultural.summary: A traditional trio of walnut leaves, resin-rich wood, and wood ash tucked in for grain protection!
cultural.how: Combine walnut leaves, pieces of Jugnu wood, and wood ash with stored grain.

cultural.summary: An unusual old trick—tucking match sticks in with stored grain to keep pests away!
cultural.how: Place match box sticks in with stored wheat grain, following local farmer practice.

cultural.summary: Store harvested wheat in a big spindle-shaped bamboo basket!
cultural.how: Store harvested wheat grain in large spindle-shaped bamboo baskets, locally called 'Perru'.
